scheme_name: Mahila Samridhi Yojana under NSKFDC- Haryana
other_conditions: Applicant must be a woman Safai Karamchari or a dependent daughter of a Safai Karamchari.

Applicant must produce a Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent issued by authorized officials such as the Head of Government Departments, elected municipal members, Pradhan of Gram Panchayat, Local Revenue Officer, Officer of Local Municipal Office, Cantonment Executive Officer, or Railways officer of gazetted rank.
benefits_summary: Provides loans up to ₹1,00,000 with 10% margin money and a subsidy of up to 50% of project cost (maximum ₹10,000) for eligible women.
documents_required: Certificate of Safai Karamchari or dependent of Safai Karamchari issued by an authorized government official.
